Application Data.NAME: First Community Bank
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: First Community Bank operates as a full-service financial institution providing a range of banking services, including personal and commercial banking, loans, savings and checking accounts, and investment services. The bank prioritizes customer service and compliance with all federal and state regulations. It employs robust cybersecurity measures to protect customer data and conducts regular audits to ensure adherence to security protocols and risk management strategies. Additionally, First Community Bank emphasizes community engagement through local sponsorships and financial education programs.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: In the past five years, First Community Bank experienced minor losses related to operational disruptions due to unexpected software updates that affected internal processes. These incidents occurred on 03/15/2021 and 07/22/2022, resulting in minimal costs of approximately $3,500 each for system recovery and downtime. Both incidents have been resolved, and there are no ongoing claims related to these losses.
